## onchain-snapshotter (hourly)
Schedule → PE status + PE shielded (platform-explorer) → ZecHub shielded/total → Zcash tip (blockchair) → Normalize → **Write snapshots → Upsert zec supply → Check dropped**.

TWO CLOCKS (DB-SCHEMA §1/§8):
- dash-platform (8 metrics): hourly state, ts=fetch, height=PE block → Write snapshots (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).
- zec_block_height (blockchair): hourly chain-tip, ts=block time, height=the height → Write snapshots.
- zec supply (ZecHub, 2 metrics): DAILY date-keyed aggregate, ts=close-date UTC midnight, height NULL, revisable → Upsert zec supply (DO UPDATE).

**SELF-HEALING (L-2).** platform-explorer dropped the `poolBalance` field on 2026-07-23 and 70 hours were lost before anyone noticed. Now `Normalize` prefers the vendor field and, when it is absent, derives `shielded_pool_balance_credits = totalShieldedIn − totalShieldedOut` — an identity that held byte-exact on 130 of 130 buckets ever observed. **BigInt, never Number:** credits are exact integers (DB-SCHEMA §1.7). The row is written under **source='derived'** (registered in metrics.source_priority) with its formula and inputs in `raw_json`, so the journal never claims the vendor said something it did not. If the inputs cannot support an EXACT derivation the value is refused, not guessed.

**Healed ≠ hidden.** `Check dropped` still fails the run for anything with no exact fallback, and `onchain-verify` names every derived metric daily — closing the data gap does not close the obligation to chase the vendor or retire the metric.

Writers are CHAINED, not fanned out, so "the gate runs after both writes" is an ordering guarantee; both carry alwaysOutputData so an empty result cannot skip it.

value_raw = EXACT string; base64-bound $1 param (no SQLi); node refs insert-safe `$('Normalize')`. Owner: onchain-intel.

INSERT INTO onchain.snapshots (ts, ts_bucket, source, asset, metric, value_raw, value_num, height, raw_json, created_at)
SELECT ts, ts_bucket, source, asset, metric, value_raw, value_num, height, raw_json, created_at
FROM jsonb_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'utf8')::jsonb)
  AS x(ts bigint, ts_bucket bigint, source text, asset text, metric text, value_raw text, value_num double precision, height bigint, raw_json text, created_at bigint)
ON CONFLICT (source, asset, metric, ts_bucket) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO onchain.snapshots (ts, ts_bucket, source, asset, metric, value_raw, value_num, height, raw_json, created_at)
SELECT ts, ts_bucket, source, asset, metric, value_raw, value_num, height, raw_json, created_at
FROM jsonb_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'utf8')::jsonb)
  AS x(ts bigint, ts_bucket bigint, source text, asset text, metric text, value_raw text, value_num double precision, height bigint, raw_json text, created_at bigint)
ON CONFLICT (source, asset, metric, ts_bucket) DO UPDATE
  SET value_raw = EXCLUDED.value_raw, value_num = EXCLUDED.value_num, raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at;
